title: The line-bundle category of a scheme family
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Define $\mathcal B_f$ as the category over $\mathit{Sch}/S$ whose objects are pairs $(T\to S,L)$, with $L$ an invertible $\mathcal O_{X_T}$-module [def-sc-invertible-module] on $X_T=X\times_ST$ [def-pc-base-change]. An arrow $(T\prime,L\prime)\to(T,L)$ consists of an $S$-morphism $u:T\prime\to T$ and an isomorphism $u_X^*L\cong L\prime$, using the actual module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. The identity uses the canonical identity-pullback comparison. Composition is pullback of the second isomorphism followed by the first, using the canonical composite-pullback comparison; these operations satisfy the category laws. Projection sends an object to $T\to S$ and an arrow to $u$. No flatness, properness, finite presentation or fibre-dimension condition is imposed on $f$.
